title: Quiz Review
description: 10 solved network quiz questions covering Chapters 1-3 with original choices, explanations, and lecture/slide references.
subject: Computer Networks

questions.question: Assume the length of a packet is 8000 bits. The speed of light propagation delay on each link is 3 × 10^8 m/sec. What is the propagation delay of link 1 (Transmission rate: 10 Mbps, Link Length: 2 Km)?
questions.explanation: Propagation delay = distance / speed = 2000 m / (3 × 10^8 m/s) = 0.00000667 seconds = 0.0067 ms.

questions.question: Assume a constant transmission rate of R=2000000 bps, a constant packet-length L=5000 bits, and a is the average rate of packets/second. Traffic intensity I=(La)/R and the queuing delay is calculated as I × (L/R) × (1-I) for I<1. Assuming that a=33, what is the queuing delay? Give your answer in milliseconds (ms).
questions.explanation: I = (5000 × 33) / 2000000 = 0.0825. Using the specific formula provided in the question prompt: Queuing Delay = 0.0825 × (5000/2000000) × (1 - 0.0825) = 0.000189 seconds = 0.19 ms.

questions.question: In AIMD sender increase their sending rate by 1/2 MSS every RTT until loss detected.
questions.explanation: In AIMD, the sender increases the sending rate by 1 MSS (Maximum Segment Size) every RTT, not 1/2 MSS.

questions.question: What is the transmission delay for a 20 Kbits packet pushed into a 100 Mbps link.
questions.explanation: Transmission delay = L / R = 20,000 bits / 100,000,000 bps = 0.0002 seconds = 0.2 ms.

questions.question: Which HTTP request method is used to send data to server
questions.explanation: The GET method can be used to send user data to the server by including the data in the URL field of the HTTP GET request message (following a '?').

questions.question: Select the HTTP response status code that indicates the requested document not found on the server
questions.explanation: The 404 status code stands for "Not Found", indicating the requested document is not on the server.

questions.question: Which application layer protocol is used to transfer email message from client to server:
questions.explanation: SMTP (Simple Mail Transfer Protocol) is used to push/transfer email messages from the client to the mail server.

questions.question: Which of the following features describe servers:
options: Servers do not communicate directly with each other.
Servers are often used in data centers
questions.correctAnswer: Servers are often used in data centers
questions.explanation: Servers are always-on hosts, typically have permanent IP addresses, and are often grouped in data centers for scaling.

questions.question: Calculate the TCP rate having a window size 262,136 bits and the RTT is 0.015 seconds.
questions.explanation: TCP Rate ≈ cwnd / RTT = 262,136 bits / 0.015 seconds = 17,475,733.33 bps.

questions.question: Calculate the sender utilization for Stop-and-wait protocol having 2000 bits packet size, link bandwidth 10 Mbps, propagation delay 5 ms?
questions.explanation: Transmission delay (L/R) = 2000 / 10,000,000 = 0.2 ms. RTT = 2 × 5 ms = 10 ms. Sender utilization U = (L/R) / (RTT + L/R) = 0.2 / 10.2 = 0.0196 or 1.96%.
